name: Invasion of Naboo
summary: The Trade Federation blockaded and occupied Naboo at the secret direction of Darth Sidious. The crisis toppled Chancellor Valorum and put Naboo's own senator, Palpatine, in his chair.

name: Palpatine is elected Supreme Chancellor
summary: Riding sympathy for Naboo, Senator Palpatine won the chancellorship. The Sith Lord now ran the Republic he intended to destroy.

name: The clone army is commissioned on Kamino
summary: An army of clones was ordered from the Kaminoans in the name of a Jedi Master, part of the Sith plan to arm the Republic for a war of the Sith's own making.

name: Battle of Geonosis; the Clone Wars begin
summary: The Jedi and the new clone army fought the Separatist droid armies on Geonosis, opening a three-year war that Palpatine controlled from both sides.

name: The Clone Wars
summary: Republic clones and Separatist droids fought across the galaxy while the Chancellor accumulated emergency powers. The war ended with the Jedi exhausted and spread thin exactly as the Sith intended.

name: Order 66

location.note: executed on every front at once

summary: Palpatine ordered the clone troopers to kill their Jedi commanders, and across the galaxy they did. The Jedi Temple was stormed and the Order all but destroyed in a day.

name: Palpatine declares the Galactic Empire
summary: Before a cheering Senate, Palpatine reorganised the twenty-five-thousand-year-old Republic into the first Galactic Empire, with himself as Emperor. The Sith ruled the galaxy openly for the first time since Ruusan.

name: The Caamas firestorm
summary: Shortly after the Empire's birth, saboteurs brought down Caamas's planetary shields and an orbital bombardment burned the pacifist world to cinders. Who had helped the Empire do it remained a poisonous question for decades.

name: The Corellian Treaty founds the Rebel Alliance
summary: Mon Mothma, Bail Organa and Garm Bel Iblis united their resistance movements into the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

name: The Death Star destroys Alderaan
summary: To demonstrate the Death Star and break Princess Leia, Grand Moff Tarkin obliterated Alderaan and its two billion people. The atrocity drove worlds across the Core toward the Rebellion.

name: Battle of Yavin
summary: Rebel starfighters launched from the Massassi temples destroyed the Death Star minutes before it could fire on Yavin 4. The victory became the galaxy's calendar epoch.

name: Battle of Hoth
summary: Darth Vader's fleet found the Rebel headquarters on Hoth and Imperial walkers overran Echo Base, scattering the Alliance across the Rim.

name: Battle of Endor
summary: The Rebel fleet destroyed the second Death Star while Luke Skywalker turned Vader back to the light; Vader killed the Emperor. The Rule of Two ended with its last master.

name: The New Republic is proclaimed

location.note: proclaimed after Endor; Coruscant retaken in 7 ABY

summary: A month after Endor the Alliance declared itself the New Republic, and over the next three years it fought the fragmenting Empire for the Core.

name: The New Republic takes Coruscant
summary: Rogue Squadron brought down the planetary shields and the New Republic captured the Imperial capital, though a bioweapon left behind nearly cost them the city.

name: Grand Admiral Thrawn's campaign

location.note: opening raid on the Sluis Van shipyards

summary: The Empire's last Grand Admiral returned from the Unknown Regions and came within a battle of retaking the Core before his own bodyguard killed him at Bilbringi.

name: The reborn Emperor's Operation Shadow Hand
summary: A clone of Palpatine emerged from the Deep Core fortress Byss with World Devastators and the Galaxy Gun, retook Coruscant for a time and was finally destroyed on Onderon.

name: The Sun Crusher destroys Carida
summary: The Jedi student Kyp Durron, possessed by the spirit of Exar Kun, used the Sun Crusher to make Carida's star go nova and wipe out the Imperial academy world.

name: Luke Skywalker founds the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4
summary: In the Massassi temples Luke Skywalker gathered the first students of a new Jedi Order, and almost lost them to the lingering spirit of Exar Kun.

name: The Yuuzhan Vong invade

location.note: first landings at Helska and Belkadan

summary: Extragalactic invaders who could not be felt in the Force struck the Outer Rim and cut their way toward the Core over four years of the worst war in galactic history.

name: The Yuuzhan Vong poison Ithor
summary: After the New Republic held the planet, a spiteful Vong commander released a bioweapon that killed every living thing on Ithor's surface.

name: The Yuuzhan Vong conquer Coruscant
summary: The galactic capital fell after a desperate defence and was terraformed into a Vong world named Yuuzhan'tar. The New Republic's government fled and collapsed.

name: The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances is formed
summary: On Mon Calamari the surviving New Republic reorganised itself as the Galactic Alliance under Cal Omas and began the counteroffensive.

name: Liberation of Coruscant and the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War
summary: The Galactic Alliance and the living world Zonama Sekot defeated the Vong at Coruscant, and the surviving invaders were settled on Sekot.

name: Second Galactic Civil War
summary: Corellia's bid for independence spiralled into a war between the Galactic Alliance and a Confederation of breakaway worlds, with Jacen Solo falling to the dark side as Darth Caedus.

name: Sith–Imperial War
summary: The Fel Empire, secretly steered by Darth Krayt's One Sith, defeated the Galactic Alliance; Krayt then seized the Imperial throne for himself.

name: Darth Krayt takes the throne on Coruscant
summary: The One Sith massacred the Jedi at Ossus and Krayt declared himself Emperor, beginning the Second Imperial Civil War against Roan Fel's loyalists.

name: Second Imperial Civil War
summary: Fel's Empire-in-exile, the Jedi and the Alliance remnant fought Krayt's Sith for seven years, ending with Krayt's death and the One Sith driven from Coruscant.
